findings.problem: Pena as embarrassment is regional (Mexico, Central America, Colombia, Venezuela), not general Latin American; in the Southern Cone and Peru me da pena means sadness and vergüenza is used, so the hint's label misleads the learner.
findings.fix: hint: Mexico, Central America, Colombia, as in me da ___; not vergüenza

back.es: la pena: embarrassment, shyness (Mexico, Central America, Colombia, Venezuela); elsewhere sorrow, pity, penalty
back.example: It embarrasses me to speak in public.

note: Spain is correctly vergüenza, but vergüenza is also the normal word in much of South America, so the regional label in the hint matters.
